content.title: Underground Ruins
content.body:
A note I found, written by someone else in the past:

"I'm not liking the vibes of this place. It was pretty terrible before, but now... I feel as if I'm always being watched everywhere I go.

I've been down in the caverns again, quite deep now where there's lake of water and scattered ruins. Some of them had decent loot, but I was more worried about the things that were looking for me rather than the things I was looking for.

There's a thick fog surrounding me, and it keeps trying to close in. There's a presence beyond that fog that is eyeing me as prey. If I get out of here alive, I might want to call of the plunder."
